inlineSql: Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE as AcCodeL, B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL,A.AC_ADD1 AS AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.AC_NAME
Select * From ADD_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As CustomerNameL,A.AC_CODE as CustCodeL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL,A.AC_ADD1 AS AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL FROM ADD_MAST AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.AC_NAME

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_FINE as FineW,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_FINE,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? TAG_NO ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ' ? '
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL, B.GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.PR_CODE As PrCodeL,A.IT_TYPE As ItTypeL,A.TAG_TYPE As TagTypeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_NAME
